reply_text:
I replied to Dana in their thread in #north-team: the latest figure is **261 seats** for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal, which Ilse posted there on Oct 14.

I couldn't confirm 261 as final. No Quarrendon files showed up in the shared files, so there's no signed renewal to check it against. I suggested Dana check with Ilse before marking it final in the tracker. The only other seat count I found is 185, from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025, and I mentioned it only so it wouldn't be mistaken for the 2026 number.

Before reading anything, I made sure Dana belongs to the channels I used (#north-team and #inc-qfl-sev1). A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share in the channel without approval.
